messages:
maria: Quick thread to propose an "evidence-fidelity" approach for enterprise customers. Problem: some customers want full raw-event retention for audits (expensive), others accept sampled or metadata-only evidence for cost reasons. Need product + eng + security + finance to triage and pick defaults + opt-in paths.

todd: we should define 3 fidelity tiers: `full` (raw payloads + receipts), `verified` (payload hashes + receipts + structured outputs), and `meta-only` (event metadata, control tags, tamper-chain). Each tier maps to storage, export size, and expected export SLA.

lara: security concern: `meta-only` must still allow control verification; include `tamper_hash`, `control_ids`, `ingest_sig`. Auditors may push back on not having full text, so we need an explicit auditor signoff flow for customers that choose lower fidelity.

nina: finance: we need clear price deltas per tier and a simple per-tenant toggle. Otherwise cost allocation is messy. rough idea: full = baseline, verified = -30% storage, meta-only = -70% storage. Need numbers validated by storage team.

kevin: legal: if a customer opts for `meta-only`, contract must include an auditor consent clause stating limits of evidence and the process to request full replays (timeboxed, may incur e-discovery fees). Also retention overrides for litigation must always preserve raw data even if tenant is on meta-only.

sam: ops notes: implement tagging at ingest: `evidence_fidelity` with value in {full, verified, meta-only}. Purge worker will act differently: full = normal retention, verified = keep structured outputs + receipts longer, meta-only = keep metadata only. Export bundle assembler needs to respect fidelity and include a `fidelity_manifest` explaining omitted artifacts.

todd: technical tradeoffs: for `verified` we can keep model outputs fingerprinted (hash + normalized output) so auditors can validate behavior without raw tokens. That reduces PII surface. We should also support a temporary escalation API: legal can request a time-limited replay (audit_request_id) that lifts fidelity for specific event ranges after approval.

lara: security adds: require `evidence_fidelity` documented in event schema and `fidelity_manifest` included in every evidence bundle. Also require per-tenant `evidence_policy_id` linked to onboarding docs.

nina: pricing model proposal: base price + per-GB storage for full, discounted per-GB for verified/meta-only. Also offer an enterprise add-on for "audit-ready" (guaranteed raw retention + expedited export SLA).

maria: proposed launch criteria for the initiative:
- spec for `evidence_fidelity` fields + `fidelity_manifest` merged
- mapping table: fidelity tier -> retention_policy, export_SLA, price delta
- contract/legal language drafted for fidelity opt-in + auditor replay process
- PoC export for each tier demonstrating bundle contents and auditor verification steps
- retention/purge tests and e-discovery replay flow tested in staging

kevin: legal will draft a short contract amendment + auditor consent language. We'll require signed consent for meta-only customers that wish to restrict raw evidence.

todd: I'll prototype `fidelity_manifest` and update PR with sample bundles. Example manifest snippet: ```json
{"bundle_id":"b-20260512-01","fidelity":"verified","omitted_assets":["raw_text_blobs"],"reason":"customer_opt_in"}```

sam: I'll add purge logic and an emergency "lift-fidelity" endpoint gated by legal approval with an audit trail. Also monitor cost impact.

lara: security will review the manifest schema and create a threat checklist for metadata-only configurations. Auditors we spoke to said they'd accept `verified` for many cases if documented.

maria: action items:@todd - PR with sample bundles + manifest, @sam - retention/purge + lift-fidelity endpoint, @nina - run cost model & pricing tiers, @kevin - contract amendment + consent template, @lara - security review + auditor notes. I'll schedule a 30-min working session next Tue.

audit-bot: Note: RFC #721 opened "evidence-fidelity-tiering" by maria. CI: schema lint OK, example bundle pending.

todd: will push sample bundles today.

maria: aim to include this in next compliance sprint. Ping if blockers.
